submittedParameters.prompt:
One standalone full-body transparent RGBA game run-animation sprite, native square at least 1024 pixels. Image1 is exact character identity; image2 direction reference; image3 approved crisp hand-painted Q-style; optional image4 only identity and scale. Preserve purple hair lotus crown, embroidered lilac-white clothes, short chibi limbs, shoes and same purple-gold qin. Facing southeast, toward lower-right, front-right three-quarter view: her anatomical RIGHT shoulder/arm/leg is nearer camera on screen-left, anatomical LEFT on farther screen-right. Keep the reference SE view. Left hand stays on elevated neck toward screen-right, right hand at low strings on screen-left.
CRITICAL POSE, redraw both legs: OPPOSITE PASSING KEY. Anatomical LEFT FAR leg (screen-right hip) supports nearly vertical, LEFT boot planted LOW on IMAGE RIGHT x620y942. Anatomical RIGHT NEAR knee (screen-left hip) rises FORWARD high and bends, RIGHT boot HIGH on IMAGE LEFT x440y845. Keep knee/ankle/hip connections visible. This is the reverse of frame04: RIGHT knee high, LEFT shoe low. Pelvis neutral, no wide split stride. Hands stay on same upper/lower qin locations.
Every body part stays attached; anatomically LEFT hand supports upper qin neck, RIGHT hand holds lower strings, no release, no switch. No mirror. Camera fixed, full character with margins, preserve image2 scale with crown around125 and ground root512,942 on virtual1024 canvas; natural body bob. Transparent background with no floor, shadow, text, VFX or contact sheet. Only one character.
